## File: facebookresearch_jacobianregularizer/examples/mnist.py

Prompts

```
['run the MNIST training script with Jacobian regularization on a simple MLP model', 'create an MLP neural network with configurable hidden layer sizes and Xavier initialization', 'evaluate a trained model computing supervised loss and Jacobian regularization loss', 'review the MLP forward pass that flattens input and applies two ReLU layers', 'test Jacobian regularization by training an MLP on MNIST with configurable lambda weight']
```

